// ==========================================================================
// THE ROBOCOP SET'S PLACEMENT PAGES -- where each gun sits in your hand.
//
// GENERATED by _pending/tools/make_menudef.py from WMCARD.robocop, alongside that set's
// CVARINFO. Both come off the same card and the same stem rule, so a slider cannot name
// a cvar that does not exist. DO NOT EDIT -- change the card and run it again.
//
// EVERY SLIDER HERE MOVES THE GUN WHILE THE MENU IS OPEN. These are renderer-read cvars;
// a menu freezes the playsim, so a slider on a script-read cvar would move nothing at the
// one moment it is wanted. That is what the LINT-LIVE lines declare and what menu_lint
// checks.
// ==========================================================================

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Robocop
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Robocop"
{
	Title "ROBOCOP -- WHERE EACH GUN SITS"
	StaticText "Pick a gun, then drag. It moves in your hand as you drag it.", 1
	StaticText "Put the gun in your hand first -- you are adjusting what you can see.", "DarkGray"
	StaticText ""
	Submenu "RC_Auto9", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_auto9"
	Submenu "RC_Chaingun", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_chaingun"
	Submenu "RC_Chainsaw", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_chainsaw"
	Submenu "RC_Cobra", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_cobra"
	Submenu "RC_KSG", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_ksg"
	Submenu "RC_M27", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_m27"
	Submenu "RC_M32", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_m32"
	Submenu "RC_Shotgun", "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_shotgun"
}

AddOptionMenu "OptionsMenu"
{
	Submenu "VR Weapons -- Robocop: where each gun sits", "WM_Place_Robocop"
}

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Robocop_rc_auto9
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Robocop_rc_auto9"
{
	Title "RC_AUTO9"
	StaticText "WHERE IT SITS ON YOUR CONTROLLER -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Left / right",   "rc_auto9_ofs_x", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	Slider "Forward / back", "rc_auto9_ofs_y", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	Slider "Down / up",      "rc_auto9_ofs_z", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	SafeCommand "Reset where it sits", "resetcvar rc_auto9_ofs_x; resetcvar rc_auto9_ofs_y; resetcvar rc_auto9_ofs_z"
	StaticText ""
	StaticText "HOW IT IS TURNED -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Yaw",   "rc_auto9_yaw",   -180, 180, 1, 0
	Slider "Pitch", "rc_auto9_pitch", -180, 180, 1, 0
	Slider "Roll",  "rc_auto9_roll",  -180, 180, 1, 0
	StaticText "Roll is the one that fixes a gun rotated like a cylinder.", "DarkGray"
	SafeCommand "Reset how it is turned", "resetcvar rc_auto9_yaw; resetcvar rc_auto9_pitch; resetcvar rc_auto9_roll"
	StaticText ""
	StaticText "HOW BIG IT IS -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Size",         "rc_auto9_scale",   0.05, 4.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along X", "rc_auto9_scale_x", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along Y", "rc_auto9_scale_y", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along Z", "rc_auto9_scale_z", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	StaticText "Above zero only -- the renderer ignores zero and below.", "DarkGray"
	SafeCommand "Reset its size", "resetcvar rc_auto9_scale; resetcvar rc_auto9_scale_x; resetcvar rc_auto9_scale_y; resetcvar rc_auto9_scale_z"
}
